title: EU Disburses €3.3 Billion to Ukraine for Missiles and Drones
detail: The European Union disbursed €3.3 billion (~$3.7B) to Ukraine on September 18 for the procurement of missiles and drones, drawn from the remaining funds of the EU's €150B SAFE defense financing program as part of the 90 billion euro Ukraine Support Loan. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced the payment following a phone call with President Zelenskyy, saying the two also discussed developing a joint European air and missile defense system building on the anti-ballistic FREYJA system. It is the fourth defense-earmarked payment under the loan program, bringing total disbursements to almost €15 billion over the past year. Zelenskyy called the initiative to use remaining SAFE funds for joint EU-Ukraine defense projects "very timely and genuinely needed."

media.caption: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announces a €3.3 billion disbursement to Ukraine for missiles and drones, Sept. 18, 2026

title: Russian Drones Destroy Amstor Shopping Mall in Zaporizhzhia
detail: Russian drones struck the Amstor shopping mall on the right bank of Zaporizhzhia late on September 17 into September 18, igniting a massive fire that spread across more than 10,000 square meters and left the complex, in the words of Ukraine's State Emergency Service, "practically destroyed." Firefighters repeatedly had to take shelter from the threat of further strikes before completing the response on the morning of September 18. Local media reported children sheltering in a nearby skatepark survived by taking cover in concrete recesses; other civilian infrastructure including buses, bus stops and businesses were also damaged in the wider barrage.

media.caption: Fire engulfs the Amstor shopping mall in Zaporizhzhia after a Russian drone strike, Sept. 18, 2026

title: Russian Drone Drops Explosives on Kherson Hospital Grounds
detail: Russian forces dropped explosives from a drone onto the grounds of a hospital in Kherson's Korabelnyi district on the afternoon of September 18, damaging several of the hospital's service vehicles, according to Kherson Military Administration head Yaroslav Shanko. No injuries were reported. The strike continued a pattern of Russian drone attacks on Kherson's civilian and medical infrastructure, including a September 11 drone strike that injured medical workers in an ambulance in the same district.
